quests.title: Tatara Tales: Data Collection

dialogue.t: Now, all we need to do is wait for our beacons to collect enough data.
Once we have that data on hand, I will make a few tweaks to this device accordingly.
Once all is ready, let us put a decisive end to this incident.
Ah, such perfect timing, Traveler! The data has almost all been gathered, and it is now time to retrieve our beacons!
That I shall, that I shall. Best to be quick, and sneaky too. Don't let those Fatui spot you!
If we are able to acquire this data, then this should make our job a lot easier.
How did it go? Do you have all our beacons?
Bravo! Now, just give me a moment while I modify this device.
I must say, the Fatui have been acting more and more strangely recently. They seem to be gathering around the core of the furnace.
Hopefully, they aren't hatching some other dastardly plot. Or should I say, trying to do something that we won't be able to mitigate...

quests.description: Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea…
